plugin.description: Sends HTTP requests from a key: fire a POST at a webhook, or fetch a value with GET and show it on the key.
plugin.requirements: Nothing. The target has to be reachable from this computer.

PostRequest.description: Sends a POST request with a json body when the key is pressed. Use it for webhooks.

json.description: The request body, as json written into a text field - so it is a string containing json, not a json object.

GetRequest.description: Sends a GET request, picks one value out of the json answer and shows it on the key. Set auto_fetch to turn it into a live readout.

headers.description: Request headers, as a string containing json. Use it for API tokens.

keys.description: Which value of the json answer to show, as a path with periods between the keys. Empty shows the whole answer.

auto_fetch.description: Fetch again every N seconds without pressing the key. 0 disables it.
